component.name: Crimson Steam Pirates
component.summary: Linux port of the 2011 naval combat strategy game (bring your own IPA)

description.p: A native Linux runtime for Crimson Steam Pirates, the 2011 iPhone-only turn-based naval combat game by Bungie / Harebrained Schemes, built on the MOAI SDK.

This application contains no game assets. On first launch it asks you to supply your own copy of the original .ipa (archived at the Internet Archive) and rebuilds the playable game from it on your machine. This is the same "bring your own game data" model used by ScummVM and other engine reimplementations.
Flatpak: first-run setup offers the HD art pack, and the manifest now builds (GNOME 50 runtime, bundled JRE, GLU, freeglut and patch).
Optional HD art pack: build with the full-resolution 1024x768 layout from the Chrome Web Store release. Fixes a crash when opening the Options menu and undersized text.
